minus_two_shield.name: Minus Two Shield
minus_two_shield.description: A single use shield that prevents a -2. Is destroyed after use.

uno_reverse.name: Uno Reverse
uno_reverse.description: Reflect a -2 back on the attacker. Is destroyed after use.

points_swap.name: Points Swap
points_swap.description: Choose a person to swap points with.

distribution.name: Point Redistribution
distribution.description: Pools all points and redistributes them evenly among all players.

bomb.name: Landmine
bomb.description: Upon recieving a -2, everyone in the immediate area also gets -2.

converter.name: Cosmic Bit Flip
converter.description: Converts the next -2 into a +2. Is destroyed after use.

debt_cancel.name: Generosity
debt_cancel.description: Clears any debt from all players! Wow you're really generous!

double_points.name: Amplifier
double_points.description: Your next +2 is doubled to +4 OR you next -2 to someone else is doubled to -4.

shrapnel.name: Thorns
shrapnel.description: Upon recieving a -2,  the two people above and below you on the leaderboard lose a point.

knight.name: Move the Knight
knight.description: Move the knight to a player of your choice. That player gets their points stolen as long as they have the knight!

veto.name: Score Veto
veto.description: Within 15 seconds of the last score, you can use your veto to cancel it.
